summary: New box Imperativ: example for sense 1 in Imperativ (PrS 42/71)
rationale: New Imperativ box: command already embedded in an old Preterit quotation, now explicitly classified. This is not a second independent attestation.

data.turoyo: Fṣiḥ u ḥmoro, nʕəlle u ḥmoro w mʕarṭazle w rahəṭ.
data.translation: Da freute sich der Esel, schrie Tor Geilheit, schlug mit den Hinterbeinen aus und lief davon;

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; overt zero-marked donkey subject. Keep the edition's Tor typo and motive wording.

data.turoyo: Nʕəlli w rahəṭno, nafəl u taʕlo mə ḥaṣi.
data.translation: ich jauchzte laut auf und lief schnell weiter. Da fiel der Fuchs von meinem Rücken herunter

rationale: Thin Preterit cell; first-person l-series braying form in the donkey's retelling.

data.turoyo: Azze u dewo, mədle lu ḥmoro, nʕəlle lu ḥmoro, kle maṣro u ḥmoro.
data.translation: Da ging der Wolf hin und packte den Esel; dieser aber schrie auf; denn er war angebunden.

rationale: Fills Preterit cell to five; l-marked sound-emitter contrasts with zero-marked donkey at PrS 66/19.

after: dröhnen; schreien, iahen (vom Esel; auch nachgeahmt);
rationale: The entry already quotes imitation of donkey braying; independent donkey subjects confirm that dröhnen alone omits the attested animal sound. Preserve the sense number.

summary: All eight records fit inherited sense 1 once its animal-sound component is made explicit. No new numbered sense is needed.
nʕəlle/nʕəlli/nʕəlla have r assimilated before the l-series suffix. The braying form is not nʕl 'shoe', even in the shoeing tale.

Sound-emitter subjects may be zero-marked (PrS 66/19 u ḥmoro) or l-marked (PrS 72/65 lu ḥmoro; cave li mʕarṯo at PrS 41/61 and 45/53). These are intransitive emitters, not recipients or experiencer objects.
PrS 42/71 nʕar is a genuine second-person Imperativ already quoted incidentally in the inherited Preterit example. Cross-filing the form adds a box, not a new occurrence count.
Reader context for PrS 74/78 includes earlier verses. The supplied verse translation is a sentence tail, so it is not used as a new standalone quotation.
